preheader: Kitchen-sink render test: full L/C/R bias bar, threads, reporting-varies, briefs, single-source, no-source.
not_covered_blurb: Also today but not covered here: routine market moves, a minor cabinet reshuffle, and three sports finals.

must_know.headline: Full-spectrum bias bar: left, centre, and right outlets covering one story
must_know.summary: Sourced across the political spectrum to exercise the three-colour bias bar with proportional segments and a multi-row web source table.
must_know.why_it_matters: Exercises the why-it-matters block alongside a full left/centre/right bias bar.

reporting_varies.angle: Framed it as a humanitarian failure and an indictment of policy.
Emphasised security, enforcement, and cost to taxpayers.

must_know.headline: Ongoing thread with a day counter and a left/right-only bar (no centre segment)
must_know.summary: This base summary should be REPLACED by the thread delta below.
must_know.why_it_matters: Checks the Ongoing eyebrow, the delta-over-summary swap, and a two-colour bar with no centre.

thread.delta: Day 13: the delta text replaces the base summary, so a returning reader sees what changed today rather than a generic re-describe of the story.

must_know.headline: Single-source must-know with no why-it-matters block
must_know.summary: Exactly one source, to check the singular 'source' wording, a single-segment bar, and a story that omits the why block.

must_know.headline: An intentionally very long headline that runs well past a single line to verify text-wrap balancing and the tight leading on multi-line serif display headings in both email and web
must_know.summary: Quiet-day thread: the eyebrow shows but the base summary is kept because there is no delta today.

must_know.headline: Story whose sources all fail the article-path guard, so no source line renders
must_know.summary: Every source URL is a bare domain, so the outlet collector drops them and the source block is omitted entirely, with no dangling bias bar.
must_know.why_it_matters: Confirms the zero-usable-source path renders cleanly.

should_know.headline: Should-know brief with a mixed left/centre/right bias bar
should_know.summary: Briefs are compact: smaller heading, summary, and the same stacked source line. This one spans the full spectrum.

should_know.headline: Second brief, single centre source
should_know.summary: A one-source brief to check spacing between consecutive briefs and the singular source wording.

should_know.headline: A third brief with a longer headline to check how briefs wrap and how the source line sits beneath a two-line compact heading
should_know.summary: Longer heading, two sources, left and centre.
